unsafe_phishing: Kutholwe umzamo wobugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi!
background_description: Ukuze ikuvikele ekuhlaselweni kwe-'Zero-Click' kanye nobugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi ngesikhathi sangempela, i-Da-Costa App idinga imvume yokuqapha izaziso divedivayisi yakho kanye nesitoreji semidiya ngemuva.
background_point1_desc: Sivimba izixhumanisi ze-WhatsApp ezinobungozi kanye nezihloko zamavidiyo ezisolisayo ngaphambi kokuba uzichofoze.
background_point2_desc: Sihlaziya ithoni yama-imeyili angenayo ukuze sibone imizamo yokkhwabanisa engaba khona 'Yesikhulu Esiphezulu'.
background_point3_desc: I-Da-Costa isebenzisa i-AI engenamiyalo. Sicubungula imethadatha yezokuphepha endaweni futhi siyisuse ngokushesha. Asilokothi sigcine izingxoxo zakho zomuntu siqu.
background_disclaimer: Ngaphandle kwalezi zimvume, i-Da-Costa ingaskena amafayela ngesandla kuphela uma uhlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe.
dashboard_subheader_full: Isimo se-SOC esihlanganisiwe siyasebenza. Unogada wangemuva wesikhathi sangempela uyaphila.
dashboard_subheader_limited: Imodi yokuskena ngesandla inikwe amandla. I-perimeter yakho ayivikelekile ngokugcwele.
dashboard_limited_mode_card_desc: Unogada Wangemuva ukhutshaziwe. Ukuvikelwa kwakho kukhawulelwe ekuskeneni ngesandla ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza. Vula ukuvikelwa okugcwele ukuze uthole ukuphepha kwesikhathi sangempela, okuzimele.
dashboard_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa njengamanje isebenza ngemodi 'Yokusebenzisana okungekho'. Uhlelo luhlola yonke imidiya engenayo, izixhumanisi, kanye nokuxhumana endaweni kusetshenziswa i-Stateless AI Inference.
dashboard_alerts_desc: Ukusakazwa kwesikhathi sangempela kusuka enjinini yezokuphepha ezimele.
account_page_desc: Phatha ulimi lwakho, okubhaliselwe, amakhredithi, kanye nezilungiselelo zezezimali.
account_limited_protection_desc: Vula Unogada Wangemuva ukuze uthole i-SSE ephelele.
account_language_region_desc: Khetha ulimi lwakho oluncamelayo lwesixhumi esibonakalayo sohlelo lokusebenza.
account_explore_premium_desc_free: Vula zonke izici bese uthola ukuskena okungenamkhawulo.
account_explore_premium_desc_premium: Buka zonke izici ze-premium bese uphatha okubhaliselwe kwakho.
payment_modal_terms_desc: Ikhokhiswe ku-Google Play. Ivuselela ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle kokuthi icishiwe amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi.
payment_modal_terms_checkbox: Ngifundile futhi ngiyavumelana Nemigomo Yokubhalisa Nokukhokha.
sovereignty_page_desc: Phatha unyawo lwakho lwedijithali kanye nezilungiselelo zemethadatha kanogada wangemuva.
sovereignty_controls_desc: Lawula ukuthi imethadatha yakho yezokuphepha igcinwa kanjani futhi ithunyelwe kanjani.
sovereignty_danger_zone_desc: Izenzo lapha zingunaphakade futhi zihambisana Nelungelo lakho Lokusulwa.
sovereignty_erasure_desc: Sula unaphakade i-akhawunti yakho, umlando wokuskena, namakhredithi asele.
sovereignty_delete_confirm_desc: Lokhu kuzosula unaphakade i-akhawunti yakho, amakhredithi, namalogi. Lesi senzo asikwazi ukuhlehliswa futhi sihambisana Nelungelo lakho Lokusulwa (GDPR/NDPR/CCPA).
sovereignty_reset_app_desc: Lokhu kuzokukhipha bese kuqala kabusha inqubo yokugibela kusukela ekuqaleni.
sovereignty_reset_confirm_desc: Lokhu kuzosula isimo sakho sokugibela bese kukukhipha, kukuvumele ukuthi udlule kokuhlangenwe nakho komsebenzisi okokuqala futhi. Idatha ye-akhawunti yakho ngeke isulwe.
sovereignty_reset_toast_desc: Uhlelo lokusebenza manje luzoqala kabusha kusukela ekuqaleni.
lure_detector_page_desc: Ubunjiniyela bezenhlalo nokutholwa kokukhwabanisa kwemidiya nemilayezo yakho.
lure_detector_logs_desc: Imiphumela yesikhathi sangempela evela kumhloli wobunjiniyela bezenhlalo we-Background Sentry.
lure_detector_zero_interaction_desc: I-Da-Costa isebenzisa ukubona kwekhompyutha kwasendaweni kanye ne-NLP ukubona amaphethini okukhwabanisa ezimweni ze-WhatsApp kanye nama-SMS ngaphandle kokulayisha okuqukethwe kwakho komuntu siqu.
lure_detector_mock_log_detail_phishing: Umzamo wobugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi yasebhange
link_scrutinizer_page_desc: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-URL okuzenzakalelayo nokuvikelwa kwesixhumanisi se-perimeter.
link_scrutinizer_logs_desc: Ukuhlaziywa kwesikhathi sangempela kwezixhumanisi ezitholwe izaziso zakho nasebhodini lokunamathisela.
link_scrutinizer_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa iqapha wonke ama-SMS angenayo kanye nezixhumanisi zemidiya yezenhlalo. Imizamo yobugebengu bokweba imininingwane ebucayi ibonwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi imakwe ngaphambi kokuthi uchofoze.
video_auditor_page_desc: Ukuhlolwa kwesihloko semidiya okuzimele nokuvinjelwa kokuxhashazwa.
video_auditor_logs_desc: Ukuhlaziywa kwesikhathi sangempela kwamafayela evidiyo amasha alondolozwe kudivayisi yakho (/WhatsApp/Media & /Download).
video_auditor_proactive_desc: I-Da-Costa iqapha isitoreji sakho ukuze uthole amafayela emidiya amasha. Ikhipha isihloko sokuqala esingu-16KB ukuze ibone ukuxhashazwa kwe-malware efihliwe ngaphambi kokuba imidiya ivulwe.
email_analyzer_page_desc: Ukutholwa kokuzenza omunye okuzenzakalelayo nokuqapha i-perimeter.
email_analyzer_logs_desc: Imiphumela yesikhathi sangempela evela kusilaleli se-IMAP se-Background Sentry.
email_analyzer_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa njengamanje iqapha ibhokisi lakho lokungenayo ukuze uthole imizamo yokukhwabanisa i-imeyili yebhizinisi (BEC) kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziywa kolimi olungenasimo.
email_accounts_page_desc: Phatha izinsizakalo zakho zokuqapha ngemuva ze-IMAP/OAuth2.
email_accounts_expired_desc: Ithokheni ye-OAuth2 iphelelwe yisikhathi. Sicela uvumelanise kabusha.
email_accounts_why_link_desc: Ngokuxhumanisa i-akhawunti yakho nge-OAuth2, i-Da-Costa isebenzisa i-IMAP IDLE ukuthola izinsongo ngesikhathi zingena ebhokisini lakho lokungenayo.
email_accounts_why_link_li2: Ukucubungula ngemuva (Asikho isidingo sokugcina uhlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe).
email_accounts_why_link_li4: Ukuhlaziywa okungenasimo: Sihlaziya amaphethini, asigcini umbhalo wakho womzimba.
admin_page_desc: Imali engenayo yesikhathi sangempela, ukusebenza, kanye nemininingwane yezokuphepha.
admin_fraud_console_desc: Buyekeza futhi wenze isenzo emisebenzini esolisayo etholwe uhlelo.
admin_export_toast_desc: Umbiko ophelele wokuphatha ulandiwe njengefayela le-JSON.
policy_privacy_intro_p1: Siyakwamukela ku-Da-Costa. Sizibophezele ekuvikeleni ubumfihlo bakho ngenkathi sinikeza ukuvikelwa okuphezulu kwe-cybersecurity. Le inqubomgomo ichaza indlela yethu 'Yokubeka Ubumfihlo Kuqala' ekucutshungulweni kwedatha, ikakhulukazi ezicini zethu ze-Unified Security Service Edge (SSE).
policy_privacy_email_p1: "I-Da-Costa App inikeza ukuvikelwa kwesikhathi sangempela ekukhwabaniseni i-imeyili yebhizinisi (BEC) kanye nobunjiniyela bezenhlalo nge-'Sihlazi sethu sethoni ye-imeyili nokuzenza omunye'."
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: Ukuze kutholakale ukuzenza omunye, uhlelo lokusebenza luhlaziya ulwazimagama, ukwakheka kwemisho, kanye nethoni yama-imeyili angenayo. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kwenziwa kusetshenziswa i-AI engenazwe.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: Asigcini umzimba wama-imeyili akho. Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina kuphela 'Isiginesha Yethoni' (ukumelwa kwezibalo kwesitayela somthumeli) endaweni kudivayisi yakho ukuze kuqhathaniswe nemilayezo engenayo yesikhathi esizayo.
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Okuqukethwe kwe-imeyili yakho akukaze kulayishwe kumaseva ethu. Kucutshungulwa esimweni sesikhashana ukuze kukhiqizwe isikolo sobungozi bezokuphepha futhi kususwe ngokushesha ngemva kokuskena.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: Unganqamula ukuqapha i-imeyili noma usule inqolobane yakho yendawo 'Yesiginesha Yethoni' nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngezilungiselelo Zedatha Nobumfihlo.
policy_privacy_guarantee2_desc: Idatha yakho yezokuphepha ayikaze isetshenziselwe ukukhangisa.
policy_privacy_guarantee3_desc: Asilandeleli ukunyakaza kwakho noma ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthole izibalo.
policy_privacy_guarantee4_desc: Imilayezo yomuntu siqu kanye nemidiya akukaze kugcinwe efwini.
policy_privacy_rights_p1: Ngaphansi kwe-GDPR, i-NDPR, ne-CCPA, unobukhosi obugcwele phezu kwedatha yakho. Ungathumela amalogi akho okuhlola, ucele ukususwa ngokushesha, noma uhoxise zonke izimvume zangemuva ngokuqondile kudeshibhodi yohlelo lokusebenza.
firstscreen_description_line1: Isango lakho elingenamakhadi lokuphepha kwezinga eliphezulu, usebenzisa i-AI eqhudelanayo ukuhlola i-metadata yamafayela ngesikhathi sangempela.
firstscreen_stateless1_desc: Sihlaziya imethadatha isikhashana. Amavidiyo akho, izixhumanisi, nemilayezo akukaze kulondolozwe.
firstscreen_stateless2_desc: Ukuvikelwa kwenzeka ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuphazamisa umsebenzi wakho.
firstscreen_consent: Ukungena okugunyaziwe kuphela. UDa-Costa usebenzisa amazinga e-FIDO2 angenamakhadi — amakhadi awadaliwe noma agcinwa.
perimeter_initialized_card_body: I-Perimeter manje isiphila. Kusukela kulo mzuzi, i-Gemini 1.5 Flash AI ihlola imvelo yakho yedijithali ngesikhathi sangempela.
perimeter_invisible_protection_body: I-Da-Costa isebenza buthule ngemuva. Uzozwa kuphela kithi uma usongo lwezinga eliphezulu, njengesixhumanisi esinobungozi noma umzamo wokuzenza omunye, luvinjelwa.
perimeter_purge_body: Ukuze sihloniphe isibopho sethu sobumfihlo bakho, sesivele siyisusile imethadatha yokusetha. Uzobona ukuthi alikho ithebhu 'Lomlando' noma 'Lelogi'—lokhu kwenziwe ngamabomu. Uma siyithola, siyayimaka, bese siyayikhohlwa.
perimeter_stay_secure_body: Ungaqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokubheka isithonjana esikhanyayo se-'Active Shield' kudeshibhodi yakho.
guide_card1_body: Akudingeki uqale ukuskena. I-AI yethu iqapha izaziso zangemuva nezihloko zefayela ngokuzenzakalelayo.
guide_card2_body: Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zigcina idatha yakho ukuze zithuthukise isevisi yazo. Thina asikwenzi lokho. Ukuskena ngakunye kuyisiqalo esisha, okuqinisekisa ukuthi izingxoxo zakho zomuntu siqu zihlala zingezakho wedwa.
guide_card3_body: Uma uthola isixhumanisi se-WhatsApp esisolisayo noma i-imeyili yokukhwabanisa, i-Da-Costa izocupha Isexwayiso se-Perimeter Esheshayo. Uma ususichithile isexwayiso, idatha ehlobene nalolo songo isulwa unaphakade.
manual_scan_center_desc: Ukuhlaziywa kokuphepha kwe-AI okufunwayo. Unogada wakho ulindele umyalo wakho.
manual_scan_lure_placeholder: Namathisela umbhalo ovela emlayezweni noma ekubuyekezeni isimo...
manual_scan_email_placeholder: Namathisela okuqukethwe komzimba okugcwele kwe-imeyili esolisayo...
manual_scan_in_progress_desc: Unogada uhlaziya idatha. Lokhu kungathatha isikhashana.
manual_scan_no_credits_desc: Buka isikhangiso esifishane ukuthola +3 izikena, noma thuthukela ku-Premium ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okungenamkhawulo.
manual_scan_input_required_desc_lure: Sicela unikeze umbhalo noma isithombe ukuze uskene.
manual_scan_input_required_desc_video: Sicela ukhethe ifayela levidiyo ukuze uskene.
manual_scan_purging_in: Kusulwa umphumela ngemizuzwana engu-{seconds} ukuze kugcinwe ubumfihlo obungenasimo...
login_magiclink_sent_desc: Bheka i-imeyili yakho ukuze uthole isixhumanisi sokungena esivikelekile.
login_magiclink_prompt_email: Sicela unikeze i-imeyili yakho ukuze uqinisekise
login_magiclink_error_invalid_link: Isixhumanisi somlingo esingavumelekile noma esiphelelwe yisikhathi.
firstscreen_register_subtitle: Bhalisa i-passkey usebenzisa ikhodi ye-QR noma ukhiye wokuphepha wangaphandle.
firstscreen_biometric_tagline: Ziqinisekise nge-Biometrics noma i-Passkey ukuze ungene ngokushesha ngaphandle kwamakhadi.
ad_rewarded_desc: Buka isikhangiso esifishane ukuthola +3 izikena ngokushesha.
ad_rewarded_failed: Isikhangiso asikwazanga ukulayisha. Sicela uzame futhi.
firstscreen_magic_subtitle: Thumela i-link ephephile ku-imeyili yakho ukuze ungenise.
firstscreen_magic_sent_body: I-link ephephile yokungenisa ithunyelwe ku-imeyili yakho.
firstscreen_magic_sent_note: Hlolamisa i-junk/spam folder yakho uma ungayitholi.
firstscreen_fido2_reassurance: Kuphephile. Da-Costa isebenzisa izindinganiso ze-FIDO2 ezingaphandle kwamakhadi.
firstscreen_missing_info_desc: Sicela ufake i-ID yomsebenzisi nenombolo yakho yokubonisa.
firstscreen_magic_missing_desc: Sicela ufake ikheli le-imeyili yakho ukuze usebenzise i-magic link.
firstscreen_magic_failed_desc: I-magic link yehluleka ukuqinisekiswa. Sicela uzame futhi.
firstscreen_passkey_registered_desc: I-passkey yakho idalwe. Manje vimba umngcele wakho.
firstscreen_missing_userid_desc: Sicela ufake i-ID yakho yomsebenzisi ukuze uqhubeke.
firstscreen_biometric_register_subtitle: Sebenzisa isigxivizo seminwe noma ukubonwa kobuso ukuze ungenise ngokushesha.
auth_error_timeout: Isicelo siphelelwe isikhathi. Iseva ingase ivuke — sicela uzame futhi.
auth_error_network: Iphutha lenethiwekhi. Sicela uhlole ukuxhumana kwakho uzame futhi.
auth_error_not_allowed: Ukuqinisekiswa kukhanselwe noma akuvunyelwe. Sicela uzame futhi.
auth_error_invalid_state: Isimo esingamukelekile. Sicela uvuselele ikhasi uzame futhi.
auth_error_registration_verify: Yehluleka ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa. Sicela uzame futhi.
auth_error_biometric_verify: Yehluleka ukuqinisekisa ukubhalisa kwe-biometric. Sicela uzame futhi.
auth_error_user_not_found: Akutholakali i-ID yomsebenzisi. Sicela uhlole uzame futhi.
auth_userid_too_long_desc: I-ID yomsebenzisi kufanele ibe nezinhlamvu ezingama-20 noma ezingaphansi. Sicela uyifupise bese uzama futhi.
auth_userid_invalid_desc: I-ID ingaba nezinhlamvu, izinombolo, kanye ne-hyphens kuphela. Akunasici elivunyelwe.
auth_error_face_not_supported_desc: Ukubonwa kobuso kwedivayisi yakho akuhlangabezani nezidingo zokuphepha zokubhalisa i-passkey. Sicela usebenzise isigxivizo somunwe noma i-PIN esikhundleni salokho.
auth_error_biometric_not_available: Ukuqinisekiswa kwe-biometric akutholakali kule divayisi. Sicela usebenzise i-passkey esikhundleni salokho.
auth_error_platform_required: I-biometric yedivayisi (isigxivizo somunwe noma ubuso obuphephile be-ID) iyadingeka. Ama-khiye okuphepha angaphandle awakusekelwa.
firstscreen_biometric_face_unsupported: Ukubonwa kobuso akusekelwa ukubhalisa kokuphepha kule divayisi. Sicela usebenzise isigxivizo somunwe noma i-PIN.
firstscreen_fingerprint_subtitle: Sebenzisa isensor sesigxivizo somunwe sedivayisi yakho ukuze ungenise ngokushesha ngaphandle kwephasiwedi.
firstscreen_fingerprint_registered_desc: Isigxivizo sakho somunwe silondoloziwe. Manje vimba umngcele wakho.
firstscreen_faceid_subtitle: Sebenzisa ukubonwa kobuso obuphephile kwedivayisi yakho ukuze ungenise ngokushesha.
firstscreen_faceid_registered_desc: Ubuso bakho be-ID bulondoloziwe. Manje vimba umngcele wakho.
firstscreen_faceid_not_supported_desc: Ukubonwa kobuso kwedivayisi yakho akuhlangabezani nezidingo zokuphepha. Sicela usebenzise isigxivizo somunwe noma i-PIN.
firstscreen_biometric_choose_desc: Khetha indlela ye-biometric oyifunayo ukuze uqinisekise.
premium_lock_desc: Leli thuluzi litholakala kuphela kubabhalisiwe be-Premium. Thuthukisa uhlelo lwakho ukuze uthole ukufinyelela.
upgrade_billing_1: Inkokhelo iya kukhutshwa ku-Google Play yakho
upgrade_billing_2: Ukubhalisa kuzivuselela ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphandle kokuba auto-renew incishwe ubuncinane iiyure ezingama-24 phambi kokuphela kwexesha.
upgrade_billing_3: Lawula noma rhoxisa nangaliphi na ixesha kwi-Google Play Store Settings. Ukususa usetyenziso akurhoxisi ngokuzenzela ubunga bakho.
upgrade_billing_4: Njengeenkonzo ye-AI engenabugosi, iimbuyekezo ezingapheleleyo zoxwebhu lwexabiso lwangoku azifumaneki.
upgrade_footer_1: Ukurhoxisa ngocoselelo olunye nge-Google Play Store.
upgrade_no_thanks: Hayi enkosi, ndihlale ndi-scan ezintlanu ngosuku
upgrade_page_subtitle: Yiya ngaphaya kweziseko nge-Executive Sentry plan.
ad_rewarded_premium_not_needed: You are on Premium. Unlimited scans active.
terms_section1_body: Ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lweDa-Costa, uyavuma ukuphethwa yile Migaqo Yesevisi. Uma ungavumi, ungasebenzisi uhlelo.
terms_billing_plans_body: Uhlelo lweDa-Costa lunikeza i-Premium ye-'Executive Sentry'. Inkokhelo iya kukhutshwa ku-Akhawunti yakho ye-Google Play ekuqinisekisweni kokuthenga.
terms_no_refunds_body: Njengeenkonzo ye-AI engenabugosi, sinikeza inani ngokushesha ekuqaleni. Ngokwenqubomgomo evamile ye-Google Play, iimbuyekezo ezingapheleleyo azifumaneki. Ukufinyelela kwakho kuzohlala kusebenza kuze kuphele isikhathi sakho esikhokhelwe.
terms_section3_body: I-Da-Costa inikeza amathuluzi okwenza ucwaningo lokuphepha kwedijithali. Uyavuma ukuthi ngeke usebenzise inkonzo yethu nganoma yikuphi uhloso olungemthetho.
terms_section4_body: Uhlelo lusebenza ngomfanekiso we-freemium. Ukusetshenziswa kwamahhala kusekwa yizikhangiso nenani elincane lokuskena nsuku zonke. Abasebenzisi bangaletha amakhredithi engeziwe noma babhalise ku-premium plan.
terms_section5_body: I-Da-Costa wuthuluzi lokuhlola ukuphepha, haikho isiqinisekiso sokuphepha. Asizimisele ngawo noma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwa ukusetshenziswa kwakho kohlelo.
deletion_request_desc: Lokhu kuzokhipha akhawunti yakho, umlando wokubhalisa, kanye ne-metadata yezokuphepha ngokuphakade.
deletion_local_note: Qaphela: Izimpawu Zezwi Le-imeyili zigcinwe ngokwasendlini kudivayisi lakho. Ukuzisula, sebenzisa umsebenzi we-'Sula i-Cache' ezilungiselweni ze-app.
deletion_stateless_body: Ngoba I-Da-Costa isebenzisa ukucutshungulwa kwe-AI okwenziwa ngaphandle kwesimo, asinayo i-database yembomvu yezimiyalezo zakho eziskeniwe, ama-URL, noma amafayela okuwasusa. Lezi zinto zihlanzwa ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphakathi kwamasekhondi angama-30 ekucutshungulweni.
deletion_initiated_desc: I-akhawunti yakho ihlelelwe ukususwa. Uzophuma manje.
sovereignty_export_toast_desc: Umbiko wakho wokuzibusa kwedijithali (GP-2026) ukhutshelwe phansi.
sovereignty_cache_toast_desc: Izimpawu zezwi zasekhaya zikhishiwe kudivayisi lakho.
sovereignty_reset_failed_desc: Ayikwazanga ukusetha kabusha isimo sohlelo lokusebenza.
splash_tagline_secondary:
Izikhulu. Ephezulu. Icacile.
Yakhiwe e-Afrika. Yomhlaba Wonke.
scan_card_desc_lure: Izinto zokudoba imininingwane nezicupho zokuphatha abantu
sms_shield_message_placeholder: Paste the suspicious SMS or call script here...
sms_shield_tip: Tip: For best results, provide both the phone number and the message you received.
dashboard_sentry_sms_note: SMS monitoring captures notification previews. For full SMS analysis use SMS & Call Shield.
dashboard_posture_desc: Calculated from scan activity, threat history & sentry status
account_free_badge_desc: I-Da-Costa Svalinn imahhala ngokuphelele. Wonke amamojula wokuskena, zonke izilimi, ukufinyelela okungenamkhawulo. Akukho okubhaliselwe okudingekayo. Azikho izikweletu ezidingekayo. Powered by Nvidia Nemotron & Azure F0.
linked_accounts_description: I-Da-Costa Svalinn izoqapha ngokuzenzakalelayo ama-akhawunti akho e-imeyili axhunyiwe ngobugebengu, ukuhlaselwa kwe-BEC, kanye nemizamo yokulingisa i-CEO - ukuthola izinsongo ngaphambi kokuzivula.
linked_accounts_providers: Abahlinzeki abasekelwe: Gmail · Ukubuka · I-imeyili yenkampani
linked_accounts_b2b_text: Izinhlangano ezifuna ukuqapha i-imeyili yangemuva yamaqembu abo, xhumana nathi ngqo:
linked_accounts_individual: Abasebenzisi ngabanye: ukuskena kwe-imeyili ngesandla kuyatholakala manje nge-Email Analyzer kudeshibhodi yakho.
